title: Stat tiles conveyor over product footage
summary: Rounded app widgets ride a single row over blurred monochrome product footage: every ~1.55 s the row steps one slot left, a new tile lands on the right and types its data in. Ends on a two-line word-by-word close on black.
use_when: A fitness, health or tracking app whose value is a handful of personal stats
Vertical social promo where the app has widgets worth more than a full screen
You have one moody product or lifestyle clip and want UI layered over it
Silent autoplay: the data and the close carry the message without VO

look.type_style: bold grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking; tile figures ~3.5 % H, end line ~2.5 % H white centred; tiny uppercase mono labels ~0.8 % H typed in

structure.shot: blurred monochrome close-up of the product (a shoe) on a grey sweep; nothing else
structure.camera: pull back: footage scale ~1.035 -> 1.00 over 0-30 fr (motion.json -3.5 %/s), springs.cameraOut
structure.motion: frame 0 black, fade up from black 8 fr (f1 dim, full by f8, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: first dark tile (clock + date) pops in centre; a white metric tile pops in to its right and fills: figure, unit, label, icon
structure.motion: tile 1 appears at f22 already full size (springs.pop, overshoot not measurable); time grows to 2 lines f27; date label typed f27-f33 (typewriter); tile 2 blank at f33, figure f40, unit f44, label + icon f46 (7 / 4 / 2 fr after landing)

structure.shot: the pair slides left one slot; a translucent third tile (session count + dot grid) appears on the right
structure.motion: row step 2.27-2.77, springs.ui ~15 fr (±0.25 s); tile 3 (glass, ~40 % white) lands at 2.90-3.00, dots first, count line 3.27, sub-label typed 3.27-3.50

structure.shot: row steps left, the clock tile leaves past the left edge; an accent-orange tile with a track-oval graphic and a best-time figure lands right
structure.motion: step f116-f128, springs.ui 12 fr (overshoot not measurable); new tile blank at f123 while sliding, graphic f125, figure f130, label typed f131-f140

structure.shot: row steps left, the white tile leaves; a black tile with a dotted gauge and the metric figure lands right
structure.motion: step ~12 fr springs.ui (±0.25 s); tile 5 blank at 5.77, gauge + figure 6.00, unit + label 6.27; gauge needle settles by 6.50

structure.shot: row steps left, the glass tile leaves; a mid-grey tile with a small dot chart and axis numbers lands right
structure.motion: step 7.00-7.27, springs.ui ~12 fr (±0.25 s); tile 6 blank at 7.50, title typed 7.77, chart dots appear 7.77-8.27 left to right; hold 0.5 s

structure.shot: tiles leave one by one; first line of the close (statement, 3 words) appears word by word over the footage, second line starts
structure.motion: orange tile out by 8.77 (2 tiles re-centre), black tile out f271, grey tile out f274 (cut-like 1-3 fr exits); words at f274, f278, f281, line 2 word 1 at f284: ~3-4 fr per word, no blur (easings.linear pop-on)

structure.shot: hard cut to black: the two-line close keeps typing (instruction line, 4 words), small mark + wordmark lockup below; holds
structure.motion: close text carries across the cut at the same position; line 2 words at f284, f287, f290, f293 (3 fr cadence); lockup present from f285, no entrance; hold 38 fr to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: accent colours the hero tile, display font for figures and the close, mono for tile labels
params.content.footage: one 10 s product or lifestyle clip, graded monochrome and softly blurred
params.content.tiles: 5-6 widgets {kind clock|metric|count|record|gauge|chart, label, value, unit, tone dark|light|glass|accent|grey}
params.content.close: two lines: a 3-word statement and a 4-word instruction
params.timing.closeHold: frames the close holds on black (default 46)

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at 0.6, 3.9 and 9.0 s; the rest from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Tiles land blank and fill in 3 stages (figure ~7 fr, unit ~4 fr, label typed ~2 fr later); that delay is what reads as 'data loading'. Row step period ~1.55 s, slide ~12 fr; only one accent tile. The close types word by word and runs across the cut to black. Footage background has no vocabulary id: proposed footage-bed; the stepping row is proposed widget-conveyor. Theme set dark: background L ~0.30 (mid grey, neither rule fits), black close. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Accent hex sampled from a keyframe crop, not palettegen.
